The '''''Bivalva contemplativa''''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Clam/Legends|clam]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Perilix]]. They exhibited multigenerational narrative semaphores, which caused dispute among the [[xeno-ethnologist]]s from the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as to whether the ''Bivalva contemplativa'' possessed true [[Sentience/Legends|sentience]]. Some of the ethnologists argued this characteristic only reflected a form of [[Hive mind/Legends|hive building]] insufficient to demonstrate true sentience, while others argued it constituted conversation between individuals.<ref name="Yoda" /> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'' to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> ''Bivalva contemplativa'' had earned the nickname: the "'''thinking clams of Perilix'''," despite the argument over their sentience remaining unresolved.<ref name="Yoda" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Bivalva contemplativa'' were first mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]'', written by [[Sean Stewart]].<ref name="Yoda" /> The [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' spelled the clam's name as the "Bivalva contemplative."<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|20|Perilix}}</ref> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Bivalvia|Bivalvia]] is a biological classification for a type of [[Mollusk/Legends|mollusk]] species that has two shells.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://paleo.cortland.edu/tutorial/Bivalves/bivalvia.htm|text=Bivalvia|work=[[Wikipedia:State University of New York at Cortland|State University of New York at Cortland]]|archivedate=20180130103234|nolive=1}}</ref>
